description: Gathers up to sixteen monophonic inputs into one polyphonic cable

inputs.text: The voltage carried by that channel of the polyphonic output; an unpatched input counts as 0V

outputs.text: The polyphonic signal; its channel count reaches as high as the highest patched input, unless a number is chosen from the menu

notes: the two-digit readout shows how many channels are being sent
menu: Channels — sets the channel count of the output: Automatic follows the highest patched input and shows the count it has worked out, or pick a number from 0 to 16
